# Board description

What is fitted and wired on one printed circuit board: derivative and package, crystal, debug interface, fitted parts and how they are connected, buses, ADC channels with the circuit in front of the pin, PWM groups with their power stage, digital inputs and outputs. Hardware only - what the software uses of it is decided by the project.

Configuration level: **Board**. File: `boards/<board>/board.yaml`. Schema: `Board` in [`tools/nxconfig/model.py`](../../tools/nxconfig/model.py).

230 fields in 47 objects. 0 fields have no description in the schema and 0 numeric fields have no unit; they are marked _missing in schema_ and _missing_. How to read the tables: [reference overview](README.md).

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Default | Allowed values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| `can` | list of [object](#f-can-list) |  | no | `[]` |  | CAN connections. |

| `i2c` | list of [object](#f-i2c-list) |  | no | `[]` |  | I2C buses. |
| `rails` | list of [object](#f-rails-list) |  | no | `[]` |  | Supply rails that sensor circuits refer to. |
| `adc` | list of [object](#f-adc-list) |  | no | `[]` |  | Analog inputs with the circuit in front of the pin. |
| `pwm` | list of [object](#f-pwm-list) |  | no | `[]` |  | **After R1.** PWM groups with their power stage. |
| `input_capture` | list of [object](#f-input_capture-list) |  | no | `[]` |  | Input capture channels. |

<a id="f-board"></a>

### `board`

Identification of the board: derivative, package, supply, clock and debug connection.

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Default | Allowed values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `board.name` | string |  | yes |  | at least 1 character, pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$` | Board name; by convention the same as the folder `boards/<board>`. |
| `board.mcu` | string |  | yes |  | at least 1 character, pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$` | Derivative fitted on the board (`derivative.name` of a file in `mcudb/`). |
| `board.package` | string |  | yes |  |  | Package of the fitted derivative, one of its `derivative.packages`; selects the pin multiplexing table. |
| `board.supply_v` | number | V | no | `null` |  | Supply voltage of the MCU. The STM32 generator chooses the flash wait states for it. Left out: not stated. |
| `board.clock` | [object](#f-board-clock) |  | no | `{}` |  | Fitted crystal or oscillator. |
| `board.debug` | [object](#f-board-debug) |  | no | `null` |  | Debug connection. Left out: the build has no flash targets. |
| `board.adc_reference_mv` | integer | mV | no | `null` | > 0 | Voltage at the ADC reference input (VREFH): scaling base of all ADC channels. |
| `board.description` | string |  | no | `null` |  | Short description of the board for the reader. |

<a id="f-board-clock"></a>

### `board.clock`

Clock sources fitted on the board.

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Default | Allowed values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `board.clock.sosc_hz` | integer | Hz | no | `null` | > 0 | Frequency of the fitted crystal or external oscillator; the clock model derives PLL and dividers from it. Left out: none fitted. |

<a id="f-board-debug"></a>

### `board.debug`

Debug connection of the board: interface, probe and clock of the flash targets.

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Default | Allowed values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `board.debug.interface` | string |  | yes |  |  | Debug interface of the connector: `JTAG`, `SWD` or `cJTAG`. |
| `board.debug.probe` | string |  | no | `null` |  | Debug probe (e.g. `J-Link EDU Mini`, `ST-LINK/V2-1`, `CMSIS-DAP`, `XDS110`); selects the flash tools. Left out: J-Link. |
| `board.debug.speed_khz` | integer | kHz | no | `null` | > 0 | Clock of the debug interface. Left out: the safe default of the flash targets (1000 kHz). |

<a id="f-devices-list"></a>

### `devices[]`

Fitted component and, if a module drives it, its wiring to the module's connections (module.yaml connect).

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Default | Allowed values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `devices[].name` | string |  | yes |  | at least 1 character, pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$` | Device name, unique on the board; buses (`spi[].device`, `can[].phy`) and the project (`modules.<device>`) refer to it. |
| `devices[].part` | string |  | yes |  |  | Part number of the fitted component (e.g. `TMC6200-TA`); matched against the `parts` patterns of the module manifests. |
| `devices[].module` | string |  | no | `null` | at least 1 character, pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$` | Module (driver) that drives the device. Left out: the module whose manifest lists the part. |
| `devices[].connect` | map of string to string |  | no | `{}` | key: at least 1 character, pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$`; value: at least 1 character, pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$` | Wiring of the module's connections: module connection -> board entry (digital output or input, ADC channel). |
| `devices[].note` | string |  | no | `null` |  | Free text for the reader; no tool evaluates it. |
| `devices[].source` | string |  | no | `null` |  | Document the part facts come from (data sheet). |
| `devices[].verify` | boolean |  | no | `false` |  | `true`: fitting or wiring is not confirmed by the source. |
| `devices[].pins` | map of string to [object](#f-devices-list-pins-key) |  | no | `{}` | key: at least 1 character, pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$` | IO-33: wiring of pins of the part itself that are no MCU connection (e.g. the HVIO and EN pins of a system basis chip): pin -> use. The module manifest lists the pins and the uses it serves (module.yaml `pins`). Left out: not described, the module leaves such pins as it found them. |

| `devices[].pins.<key>.note` | string |  | no | `null` |  | Free text for the reader; no tool evaluates it. |

### `adc[]`

Analog input of the board: converter channel, pin and the circuit in front of the pin.

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Default | Allowed values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `adc[].name` | string |  | yes |  | at least 1 character, pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$` | Channel name (e.g. the net name); the project and the RTE signals `adc.*.<NAME>` refer to it. |
| `adc[].instance` | string |  | yes |  |  | ADC instance of the derivative (e.g. `ADC0`). |

| `adc[].scale` | [object](#f-adc-list-scale) |  | no | `{}` |  | Conversion of the pin voltage to the value in mV (`adc.mv`). |
| `adc[].sensor` | one of [object (kind: linear)](#f-adc-list-sensor-kind-linear) or [object (kind: shunt_amplifier)](#f-adc-list-sensor-kind-shunt_amplifier) or [object (kind: divider)](#f-adc-list-sensor-kind-divider) or [object (kind: pullup)](#f-adc-list-sensor-kind-pullup) or [object (kind: highside_is)](#f-adc-list-sensor-kind-highside_is), selected by `kind` |  | no | `null` |  | Circuit in front of the pin that turns the pin voltage into the quantity at the connector (`adc.phys.<NAME>`). Left out: no physical value. |
| `adc[].fitted` | boolean |  | no | `true` |  | `false`: the circuit is not fitted, the pin reads nothing useful. |
| `adc[].note` | string |  | no | `null` |  | Free text for the reader; no tool evaluates it. |

<a id="f-adc-list-scale"></a>

### `adc[].scale`

Value in mV = pin voltage * factor + offset_mv; divider: factor = (r_top + r_bottom) / r_bottom.

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Default | Allowed values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `adc[].scale.factor` | number | V/V | no | `null` | > 0, finite | Ratio of the measured voltage to the pin voltage. Give either `factor` or `divider`; neither: 1. |
| `adc[].scale.divider` | [object](#f-adc-list-scale-divider) |  | no | `null` |  | Resistor divider the factor is calculated from. |
| `adc[].scale.offset_mv` | integer | mV | no | `0` | -2^31 to 2^31-1 | Offset added after the factor. |
| `adc[].scale.verify` | boolean |  | no | `false` |  | Same as [`rails[].verify`](#f-rails-list). |

<a id="f-adc-list-scale-divider"></a>

### `adc[].scale.divider`

Resistor divider in front of an ADC pin; only the ratio of the two resistors counts.

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Default | Allowed values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `adc[].scale.divider.r_top` | number | Ω | yes |  | ≥ 0 | Resistor between the measured voltage and the pin. |
| `adc[].scale.divider.r_bottom` | number | Ω | yes |  | > 0 | Resistor between the pin and ground. |

<a id="f-adc-list-sensor-kind-linear"></a>

### `adc[].sensor` (kind: linear)

value = pin_mV * gain_num / gain_den + offset (unit).

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Default | Allowed values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `adc[].sensor.source` | string |  | no | `null` |  | Data sheet or schematic the values come from. |
| `adc[].sensor.verify` | boolean |  | no | `false` |  | `true`: a value is not confirmed by the source. |
| `adc[].sensor.note` | string |  | no | `null` |  | Free text for the reader; no tool evaluates it. |
| `adc[].sensor.kind` | string |  | yes |  | `linear` | Circuit type: linear characteristic of the pin voltage. |
| `adc[].sensor.unit` | string |  | yes |  | `mV`, `mA`, `ohm`, `ddegC`, `permille` | Unit of the value the circuit delivers (`adc.phys` of the channel). |
| `adc[].sensor.gain_num` | integer | unit of `unit` per mV | yes |  | -2^31 to 2^31-1 | Numerator of the gain; not 0. |
| `adc[].sensor.gain_den` | integer | none | no | `1` | > 0, ≤ 2^31-1 | Denominator of the gain, for gains that are no integer. |
| `adc[].sensor.offset` | integer | unit of `unit` | no | `0` | -2^31 to 2^31-1 | Offset added after the gain. |

<a id="f-adc-list-sensor-kind-shunt_amplifier"></a>

### `adc[].sensor` (kind: shunt_amplifier)

Current in mA = (pin_mV - reference_mV) * gain_den / gain / shunt (shunt amplifier with output offset).

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Default | Allowed values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `adc[].sensor.source` | string |  | no | `null` |  | Data sheet or schematic the values come from. |
| `adc[].sensor.verify` | boolean |  | no | `false` |  | `true`: a value is not confirmed by the source. |
| `adc[].sensor.note` | string |  | no | `null` |  | Free text for the reader; no tool evaluates it. |
| `adc[].sensor.kind` | string |  | yes |  | `shunt_amplifier` | Circuit type: shunt resistor with current sense amplifier; delivers the current in mA. |
| `adc[].sensor.shunt_uohm` | integer | µΩ | yes |  | > 0, ≤ 2^31-1 | Resistance of the shunt. |
| `adc[].sensor.gain` | integer | V/V | yes |  | > 0, ≤ 2^31-1 | Voltage gain of the amplifier; for a gain that is no integer, gain / gain_den. |
| `adc[].sensor.gain_den` | integer | none | no | `1` | > 0, ≤ 2^31-1 | Denominator of the gain, for gains that are no integer. |
| `adc[].sensor.reference` | [object](#f-adc-list-sensor-reference-kind-shunt_amplifier) |  | yes |  |  | Output voltage of the amplifier at 0 A (its REF pins). |
| `adc[].sensor.output_min_mv` | integer | mV | no | `null` | 0 to 2^31-1 | Lower end of the linear output range (swing to GND); below it the channel reports a range error. Left out: no limit. |
| `adc[].sensor.output_max_mv` | integer | mV | no | `null` | 0 to 2^31-1 | Upper end of the linear output range (swing to the supply); above it the channel reports a range error. Left out: no limit. |

<a id="f-adc-list-sensor-reference-kind-shunt_amplifier"></a>

### `adc[].sensor.reference` (kind: shunt_amplifier)

A voltage of the board a sensor circuit refers to: a named rail (board.rails) or a fixed value.

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Default | Allowed values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `adc[].sensor.reference.rail` | string |  | no | `null` | at least 1 character, pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$` | Supply rail of the board (`rails[].name`). Give either `rail` or `mv`. |
| `adc[].sensor.reference.mv` | integer | mV | no | `null` | 0 to 2^31-1 | Fixed voltage, instead of a rail. |
| `adc[].sensor.reference.ratio_permille` | integer | ‰ | no | `1000` | 0 to 1000 | Share of the rail that applies (e.g. 500 for an amplifier reference halfway between GND and the rail). Only with `rail`. |

<a id="f-adc-list-sensor-kind-divider"></a>

### `adc[].sensor` (kind: divider)

Voltage in mV at the connector = pin_mV * (r_top + r_bottom) / r_bottom.

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Default | Allowed values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `adc[].sensor.source` | string |  | no | `null` |  | Data sheet or schematic the values come from. |
| `adc[].sensor.verify` | boolean |  | no | `false` |  | `true`: a value is not confirmed by the source. |
| `adc[].sensor.note` | string |  | no | `null` |  | Free text for the reader; no tool evaluates it. |
| `adc[].sensor.kind` | string |  | yes |  | `divider` | Circuit type: resistor divider; delivers the voltage at the connector in mV. |
| `adc[].sensor.r_top_ohm` | integer | Ω | yes |  | 0 to 2^31-1 | Resistor between the connector and the pin. |
| `adc[].sensor.r_bottom_ohm` | integer | Ω | yes |  | > 0, ≤ 2^31-1 | Resistor between the pin and ground. |

<a id="f-adc-list-sensor-kind-pullup"></a>

### `adc[].sensor` (kind: pullup)

Resistance in ohm to GND = pullup * U / (supply - diode - U), U = pin voltage.

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Default | Allowed values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `adc[].sensor.source` | string |  | no | `null` |  | Data sheet or schematic the values come from. |
| `adc[].sensor.verify` | boolean |  | no | `false` |  | `true`: a value is not confirmed by the source. |
| `adc[].sensor.note` | string |  | no | `null` |  | Free text for the reader; no tool evaluates it. |
| `adc[].sensor.kind` | string |  | yes |  | `pullup` | Circuit type: pull-up resistor to a supply; delivers the resistance to GND at the connector in ohm. |
| `adc[].sensor.pullup_ohm` | integer | Ω | yes |  | > 0, ≤ 2^31-1 | Pull-up resistor. |
| `adc[].sensor.supply` | [object](#f-adc-list-sensor-supply-kind-pullup) |  | yes |  |  | Voltage the pull-up is connected to. |
| `adc[].sensor.diode_mv` | integer | mV | no | `0` | 0 to 2^31-1 | Forward voltage of a diode in series to the pull-up; 0: none. |

<a id="f-adc-list-sensor-supply-kind-pullup"></a>

### `adc[].sensor.supply` (kind: pullup)

A voltage of the board a sensor circuit refers to: a named rail (board.rails) or a fixed value.

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Default | Allowed values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `adc[].sensor.supply.rail` | string |  | no | `null` | at least 1 character, pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$` | Supply rail of the board (`rails[].name`). Give either `rail` or `mv`. |
| `adc[].sensor.supply.mv` | integer | mV | no | `null` | 0 to 2^31-1 | Fixed voltage, instead of a rail. |
| `adc[].sensor.supply.ratio_permille` | integer | ‰ | no | `1000` | 0 to 1000 | Same as [`adc[].sensor.reference.ratio_permille`](#f-adc-list-sensor-reference-kind-shunt_amplifier). |

<a id="f-adc-list-sensor-kind-highside_is"></a>

### `adc[].sensor` (kind: highside_is)

Load current in mA of a smart high-side switch = k_ILIS * U_IS / R_IS (U_IS in mV, R_IS in ohm).

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Default | Allowed values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `adc[].sensor.source` | string |  | no | `null` |  | Data sheet or schematic the values come from. |
| `adc[].sensor.verify` | boolean |  | no | `false` |  | `true`: a value is not confirmed by the source. |
| `adc[].sensor.note` | string |  | no | `null` |  | Free text for the reader; no tool evaluates it. |
| `adc[].sensor.kind` | string |  | yes |  | `highside_is` | Circuit type: current sense output (IS) of a smart high-side switch; delivers the load current in mA. |
| `adc[].sensor.device` | string |  | yes |  | at least 1 character, pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$` | Board device of the switch (`devices[].name`); its `connect.is` is this channel. |
| `adc[].sensor.k_ilis` | integer | A/A | yes |  | > 0, ≤ 2^31-1 | Current sense ratio I_L / I_IS of the switch (data sheet k_ILIS). |
| `adc[].sensor.r_is_ohm` | integer | Ω | yes |  | > 0, ≤ 2^31-1 | Sense resistor at the IS pin. |

<a id="f-input_capture-list"></a>

### `input_capture[]`

Timer channel of the board used to capture edges of an input signal.

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Default | Allowed values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input_capture[].name` | string |  | yes |  | at least 1 character, pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$` | Same as [`spi[].name`](#f-spi-list). |
| `input_capture[].instance` | string |  | yes |  |  | Timer instance of the derivative (e.g. `FTM1`). |
| `input_capture[].channel` | integer | none | yes |  | ≥ 0 | Channel number of the timer instance. |
| `input_capture[].pin` | string |  | yes |  |  | Pin name of the derivative (e.g. `PTC2`), matching `derivative.pin_pattern`. |
| `input_capture[].pad` | integer | none | no | `null` | > 0 | Same as [`spi[].sck.pad`](#f-spi-list-sck). |
| `input_capture[].note` | string |  | no | `null` |  | Free text for the reader; no tool evaluates it. |

<a id="f-dio"></a>

### `dio`

Digital inputs and outputs of the board.

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Default | Allowed values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dio.inputs` | list of [object](#f-dio-inputs-list) |  | no | `[]` |  | Digital inputs. |
| `dio.outputs` | list of [object](#f-dio-outputs-list) |  | no | `[]` |  | Digital outputs. |

<a id="f-dio-inputs-list"></a>

### `dio.inputs[]`

Digital input of the board.

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Default | Allowed values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dio.inputs[].name` | string |  | yes |  | at least 1 character, pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$` | Input name (e.g. the net name); the RTE signal `dio.in.<NAME>` refers to it. |
| `dio.inputs[].pin` | string |  | yes |  |  | Pin name of the derivative (e.g. `PTC2`), matching `derivative.pin_pattern`. |
| `dio.inputs[].pad` | integer | none | no | `null` | > 0 | Same as [`spi[].sck.pad`](#f-spi-list-sck). |
| `dio.inputs[].active` | string |  | no | `"high"` | `high`, `low` | Pin level at which the input counts as active (true). |
| `dio.inputs[].pull` | string |  | no | `null` | `up`, `down` | Pull resistor the MCU must switch on. Left out: none (the board provides the level). |
| `dio.inputs[].verify` | boolean |  | no | `false` |  | Same as [`rails[].verify`](#f-rails-list). |

<a id="f-dio-outputs-list"></a>

### `dio.outputs[]`

Digital output of the board.

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Default | Allowed values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dio.outputs[].name` | string |  | yes |  | at least 1 character, pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$` | Output name (e.g. the net name); the RTE target `dio.out.<NAME>` and the project refer to it. |
| `dio.outputs[].pin` | string |  | yes |  |  | Pin name of the derivative (e.g. `PTC2`), matching `derivative.pin_pattern`. |
| `dio.outputs[].pad` | integer | none | no | `null` | > 0 | Same as [`spi[].sck.pad`](#f-spi-list-sck). |
| `dio.outputs[].active` | string |  | no | `"high"` | `high`, `low` | Pin level of the active (switched on) state. Outputs start inactive. |
| `dio.outputs[].verify` | boolean |  | no | `false` |  | Same as [`rails[].verify`](#f-rails-list). |
